1: =========================
2: lxml_html_clean changelog
3: =========================
4: 
5: 
6: 0.4.5 (2026-05-20)
7: ==================
8: 
9: Bugs fixed
10: ----------
11: 
12: * Fixed a security vulnerability where ``javascript:`` URLs in ``xlink:href``
13:   attributes were not sanitized when``safe_attrs_only=False``, allowing
14:   cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks. The fix requires ``lxml>=6.1.1``,
15:   which adds ``xlink:href`` to the set of link attributes iterated by
16:   ``rewrite_links()``. Reported by Guillem Lefait (@glefait).
17: 
18: 0.4.4 (2026-02-26)
19: ==================
20: 
21: Bugs fixed
22: ----------
23: 
24: * Fixed a bug where Unicode escapes in CSS were not properly decoded
25:   before security checks. This prevents attackers from bypassing filters
26:   using escape sequences. (CVE-2026-28348)
27: * Fixed a security issue where ``<base>`` tags could be used for URL
28:   hijacking attacks. The ``<base>`` tag is now automatically removed
29:   whenever the ``<head>`` tag is removed (via ``page_structure=True``
30:   or manual configuration), as ``<base>`` must be inside ``<head>``
31:   according to HTML specifications. (CVE-2026-28350)
32:
